annotations.title: Link a workbook to a drive file

description: Makes a Google Drive or Dropbox file the document of record for a workbook, so each version is written back to it. `unlink` stops that; `pull` brings the file's latest in now.

path.description: The file on a mount, as the shell names it: `googledrive/Sites/339 15th St/Rent Builder.xlsx` or `dropbox/memo.docx`.

pull.description: true to read the linked file now and write it as a version.

unlink.description: true to stop syncing with the linked file.

name: link_workbook
title: Link a workbook to a drive file
